props.text: Everyday objects crafted for enduring life.

Founded in 2021, Lumina was born from frustration with disposable design. We partner with legacy manufacturers who take pride in their trade, using non-toxic glazes, vegetable-tanned leathers, and recycled solid brass that develops rich character over decades of use.
